mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over a 6-month horizon signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% in 6 months while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening housing market, which historically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as construction sector earnings improve.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above its 12-month moving average while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over a 3-month horizon signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profit margins compress.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 5.5% while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 65% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average signals disinflationary pressures, which historically correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates decline and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL declines below its 12-month moving average while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of cases.
